description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

description.name: Ancient Tree, Rope Bridge
description.description: This massive, ancient silverwood tree rises up proudly from the forest floor. Its long, slender branches are covered in golden-hued leaves, and a multitude of birds living here fill the forest with song. Wooden steps lead up from the platform around the bole of the tree here. Attached to the platform, a rope bridge stretched between this tree and another leads off to the east.

description.name: Misty Bog
description.description: This haunting, claustrophobic marsh is filled a clinging mist which leaves the skin feeling cold and clammy. Strange cries echo, muffled, in the heavy air, and shadows move just beyond the vision. The ground here degenerates into a murky marsh, filled with spiky roots and floating clumps of moss. The water reeks foully with an choking, acrid odour, but fortunately it is only knee-deep. The occasional feeling of something brushing against you leaves you feeling uneasy.

description.name: Hazy Swamp
description.description: This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.

description.name: Spiral Stairway
description.description: The hallway here turns into a stairwell that spirals upwards. At certain points it levels out into another floor, then continues its relentless ascent. Odd runes are carved all over the walls and the steps are stone cold.

description.name: Earthen Tunnel
description.description: These narrow tunnels are made of packed earth and stones, laborously burrowed deep down into the earth. They are long and dark and often bend so that losing one's way is practically inevitable.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels
description.description: You are on a wide path that winds along at a steep slope. The black rock that shapes these uneven walls seems to absorb the light around you. Thick mold grows in the crevices of the walls, filling the air with moisture. You hear soft whispering noises, and wonder what might be in here with you.

description.name: Training Grounds
description.description: You are in a well lit corridor. Symbols of battle and war decorate the walls, hand-drawn in the blood of victims. Sounds of combat echo the halls, leaving you to wonder which direction they come from.

description.name: Arlysia, Outer Wall
description.description: A high stone wall surrounds the city of Arlysia. Guards placed along the wall in strategic locations help keep the area near the city walls safe from harm. Even from this distance, the guards manage to look tense and alert, as if they were expecting an attack at any time. There are gated entrances into the city at the north and south ends.

description.name: Junkyard
description.description: This dirty, rectangular plot is filled with all manner of heavy, useless objects, such as smashed statues, ruined carts, mangled furniture, and corroded armour. In the centre of the lot stands a strange, gleaming metal contraption, emblazoned with the High Guild of Magery's seal. A plaque on the opposite side to the seal apparently details instructions on its use.

Even from this distance, the guards manage to look tense and alert, as if they were expecting an attack at any time. There are gated entrances into the city at the north and south ends.

description.name: Jail Cell
description.description: This is a small, cold, stone cell. It has a crude wooden bench to lay on, and a glory-hole in the corner, but otherwise the room is bare.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. description.name: Filthy Encampment
description.description: Here the forest has been completely destroyed-- trees chopped down, stumps dug out, and everything burned to ash. The earth has been torn and trodden on by many booted feet. Filthy paths lead north and west, and a wide swath of ruined forest is to the southwest.

description.name: Rocky Plain Path
description.description: This broad, flat plateau stretches between the swamp and mount Khazarad. It is littered with small, irregular stones, and has little vegetation save for some hardy weeds. A worn path cleared free of rock passes across the plain here.

description.name: Hazy Swamp
description.description: This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.

description.name: Spiral Stairway
description.description: The hallway here turns into a stairwell that spirals upwards. At certain points it levels out into another floor, then continues its relentless ascent. Odd runes are carved all over the walls and the steps are stone cold.

description.name: Earthen Tunnel
description.description: These narrow tunnels are made of packed earth and stones, laborously burrowed deep down into the earth. They are long and dark and often bend so that losing one's way is practically inevitable.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels

description.name: Earthen Tunnel

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels
description.description: You are on a wide path that winds along at a steep incline. The black rock that shapes these uneven walls seems to absorb the light around you. Thick mold grows in the crevices of the walls, filling the air with moisture. You hear soft whispering noises, and wonder what might be in here with you.

description.name: Treetops
description.description: You walk out on a low hanging branch that almost touches the northern cliffs. A small overhang on the other side looks as if there is enough room to stand on it. A large vine that grows out of the side of the cliff just touches the end of the branch.

description.name: Arlysia, Outer Wall
description.description: A high stone wall surrounds the city of Arlysia. Guards placed along the wall in strategic locations help keep the area near the city walls safe from harm. Even from this distance, the guards manage to look tense and alert, as if they were expecting an attack at any time. There are gated entrances into the city at the north and south ends.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills

description.name: Encampment Bonfire

Dirty bedrolls litter the encampment, and trash has been carelessly tossed all over. A massive bonfire burns in the centre of this area, the torched corpses of animals and tree trunks roasting away within. Bones litter the fringe of the fire, as do many battered iron pots and plates.

description.name: Gnome Village

The smell of baking bread and tilled fields fills the air, and the sound of busily toiling gnomes comes from every direction. A stone building to the north appears to be a store of sorts, and sounds of clanking crockery come from the one to the south.

description.name: Hazy Swamp

The huge dual doors once sealing off this arch from the outside world now lay burnt and shattered just within the opening. The muddy ground gives way to a tiled walk inside, upon which many footprints can be seen.

These wide streets lead off to the west, northwest and southwest, their blue tiles often shattered, exposing the black earth beneath. To the east, a large arch leads out into the inner bailey of the entrance gate. A feeling of cursed doom pervades the area.

description.name: Dark-Elf Castle, Gatehouse

A great chain snaking out from beneath it disappears into a hole near the ceiling, and connects to unseen gears and devices that open and close the large gate which dominates the wall. Hallways lead off to the south, east and west.

Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.

description.name: Castle, Dark Hallway
description.description: This wide hall is constructed of granite walls and floors and is devoid of any decorations. The air is quite cold and provides a nice accompaniment to the eerie soundlessness of the area. A feeling of watchfulness is everywhere.

description.name: Earthen Tunnel
description.description: These narrow tunnels are made of packed earth and stones, laborously burrowed deep down into the earth. They are long and dark and often bend so that losing one's way is practically inevitable.

description.name: Scorching Desert, Mountain Wall
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland. The desert washes up againt the side of the mountain to the south.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels
description.description: You are on a wide path that winds along at a steep incline. The black rock that shapes these uneven walls seems to absorb the light around you. Thick mold grows in the crevices of the walls, filling the air with moisture. You hear soft whispering noises, and wonder what might be in here with you.

description.name: Treetops
description.description: You climb through the treetops of an ancient tree. The tree towers above the Lost City, making you dizzy when you look down. The northern section of the tree looks like it might barely reach the cliffs. You notice a strip of bark that seems to be hanging loosely from the trunk.

description.name: Arlysia, Outer Wall
description.description: A high stone wall surrounds the city of Arlysia. Guards placed along the wall in strategic locations help keep the area near the city walls safe from harm. Even from this distance, the guards manage to look tense and alert, as if they were expecting an attack at any time. There are gated entrances into the city at the north and south ends.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel, Junction
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

description.name: Crumbling House

description.name: Home of the Enchantress
description.description: This odd wooden house appears much larger on the inside than it did on the outside. It is immaculately kept-- not a spot of dust or dirt can be found within. A long table against one wall is covered with an array of strange objects, and beside it stands a filled bookshelf.

description.name: Scorching Desert, Mountain Wall
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland. The desert washes up againt the side of the mountain to the south.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels
description.description: You are on a wide path that winds along at a steep incline. The black rock that shapes these uneven walls seems to absorb the light around you. Thick mold grows in the crevices of the walls, filling the air with moisture. You hear soft whispering noises, and wonder what might be in here with you.

description.name: Lagoon, Reef
description.description: The reef actually comes out of the water here, making it possible to walk across it. Small tide pools filled with small crabs and other shellfish liter the reef's surface. Walking is a little awkward as the rough coral edges make your footing less stable then you would like. Often, a large shape is visible in the waters beyond the reef.

description.name: Blackwood Forest, Winding Trail
description.description: This trail leads through a dark forest, thick with trees and brush. Snow weighs down the branches and occasionally falls in clumps to the ground as the wind shifts.  There is an abnormal chill that reaches deep into your bones as you travel through here.  Despite the snow, a faint stench of rot wafts on the breeze.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

description.name: Ancient Coliseum, Arena
description.description: This huge circular arena once sponsored massive gladitorial battles. Its sandy floor bears dark patches of old bloodstains, and bones literally cover most of the ground. Shattered weapons, scraps of armour and tattered clothing lay in heaps about the arena, and the stench of some massive beast indicate this is a recently-frequented lair.

description.name: Tilled Fields
description.description: This broad field has rows of neatly tilled soil. The smell of the freshly-turned earth is quite pleasant, and the earth itself is soft underfoot. Some of the fields sport tall crops, while others lay just planted.

description.name: Hazy Swamp
description.description: This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.

description.name: Castle, Dark Hallway

description.name: Winding Stair

description.name: Earthen Tunnel

description.description: This packed-earth path winds its way between the wood and stone buildings on the gnomish village. It appears to be well-used but also well-kept.

description.name: Hazy Swamp
description.description: This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence. A large island to the northeast looms ominously.

description.name: Basement Hallway
description.description: This dank passage stretches on into the darkness. The bare walls are riddled with damp cracks and musty lichen. Sounds echo strangely down here, and occasionally the splattering of a falling droplet can be heard.

description.name: Earthen Tunnel
description.description: These narrow tunnels are made of packed earth and stones, laborously burrowed deep down into the earth. They are long and dark and often bend so that losing one's way is practically inevitable.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels
description.description: You are on a wide path that winds along at a soft incline. The black rock that shapes these uneven walls seems to absorb the light around you. Thick mold grows in the crevices of the walls, filling the air with moisture. You hear soft whispering noises, and wonder what might be in here with you.

description.name: Lagoon, Reef
description.description: The reef actually comes out of the water here, making it possible to walk across it. Small tide pools filled with small crabs and other shellfish liter the reef's surface. Walking is a little awkward as the rough coral edges make your footing less stable then you would like. Often, a large shape is visible in the waters beyond the reef.

description.name: Blackwood Forest, Winding Trail

description.name: Sewer Tunnel, Intersection

Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: City Centre, Museum

Now splintered wood and shattered wares litter the ground, and bones scattered here and there by the broken stalls indicate some of the sellers didn't leave their stands even when this cataclysm happened. In the centre of the plaza is a gaudy museum, its steps leading up inside. To the east and west, giant mounds of rubble block exit.

There is an abnormal chill that reaches deep into your bones as you travel through here.  Despite the snow, a faint stench of rot wafts on the breeze.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

description.name: Icy Tunnel, Ladder Up
description.description: This large stone tunnel has been carefully cut out of the rock beneath the city. Its surfaces are completely coated in a thick layer of ice, but what created this intense cold is not apparent. Icicles hang from the ceiling like frigid teeth, and the floor is covered with powdery snow-like ice shavings. The tunnel heads off to the northeast here, and an icy iron ladder goes up through a wooden trapdoor in the ceiling.

description.name: Gnome Village
description.description: This packed-earth path winds its way between the wood and stone buildings on the gnomish village. It appears to be well-used but also well-kept. The path ends at the edge of a broad farmer's field to the east.

description.name: Hazy Swamp
description.description: This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence. A wide earthen path leads to an island to the south.

description.name: Storage Room
description.description: This is a standard dry good storage room, with crates and boxes filled to the brim with food stacked against the walls. Little bits of food scattered about the floor are occasionally snatched by small ratlike creatures which dart out of holes in the floor.

description.name: Earthen Tunnel
description.description: These narrow tunnels are made of packed earth and stones, laborously burrowed deep down into the earth. They are long and dark and often bend so that losing one's way is practically inevitable.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels
description.description: You are on a wide path that winds along at a soft incline. The black rock that shapes these uneven walls seems to absorb the light around you. Thick mold grows in the crevices of the walls, filling the air with moisture. You hear soft whispering noises, and wonder what might be in here with you.

description.name: Lagoon, Reef
description.description: The reef actually comes out of the water here, making it possible to walk across it. Small tide pools filled with small crabs and other shellfish liter the reef's surface. Walking is a little awkward as the rough coral edges make your footing less stable then you would like. Often, a large shape is visible in the waters beyond the reef.

A tall archway leads into the heart of the library to the north, and the stairs lead out southwest.

description.name: Abandoned Barracks
description.description: This massive stone building was obviously once meant to be a barracks for the city garrison. Its many beds have all been overturned or smashed, as has every other piece of furniture or decoration-- this area is even more of a shambles than the rest of the city. A battered iron staircase leads up in the centre of the room, and a doorless arch leads south. The empty front doorway allows passage onto the street.

description.name: Cluttered Workshop
description.description: This is perhaps the most chaotically cluttered room you have ever seen. It is filled with tables, all covered in strange devices or bubbling beakers, or piles of precariously-balanced books that threaten to teeter over at any moment. In a far corner is a massive glass vat, from which a tube runs to a metal cylinder as big as a man. The shaft from the waterwheel outside runs into this cylinder, which in turn pumps what appears to be water into the glass vat.

The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels
description.description: You are on a wide path that winds along at a soft incline. The black rock that shapes these uneven walls seems to absorb the light around you. Thick mold grows in the crevices of the walls, filling the air with moisture. You hear soft whispering noises, and wonder what might be in here with you.

description.name: Barren Hills, Valley Wall
description.description: A steep valley wall to the east looks impassible. The dirt and rocks holding it together are loosely packed and crumble when you attempt to climb. A narrow track winds to the north and south. The land is completely devoid of vegetation here. Ocassionally a path or dry creek bed branches off to the west.

description.name: Blackwood Forest, Winding Trail
description.description: This trail leads through a dark forest, thick with trees and brush. Snow weighs down the branches and occasionally falls in clumps to the ground as the wind shifts.  There is an abnormal chill that reaches deep into your bones as you travel through here.  Despite the snow, a faint stench of rot wafts on the breeze.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills, Crater's Edge
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. To the west, a massive crater steams violently. Who or what created such destruction remains to be seen.

description.name: Sacked Office, Bonepile
description.description: This small office has been cleared of everything of note, and filled nearly to the top with the bones of hundreds of people. Nearly all appear to have been slashed or chewed, and many of the skulls have been crushed. Miscellaneous twisted pieces of equipment are also present, but are well beyond use. The only apparent exit is through the doorless arch to the north.

description.name: Alchemist's Hut
description.description: This dimly-lit room is dominated by a massive black cauldron sitting in the firepit in the centre of the room. Something bubbles and froths within it, filling the air with a tangy scent. Shelves of empty glass bottles cover one wall, while shelves of full ones cover another. Many bunches of herbs and roots hang from the ceiling in small wooden baskets.

description.name: Hazy Swamp
description.description: This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.

description.name: Black Moat
description.description: This foul, stinking moat is filled with rotten vegetation and the gnawed carcasses of all manner of beast, humanoid and otherwise. Raw sewage floats casually about in large, greasy slicks, and clings to your clothes and hair. The density and stickiness of the murky soup makes it difficult to swim and impossible not to swallow some of the revolting filth.

description.name: Earthen Tunnel
description.description: These narrow tunnels are made of packed earth and stones, laborously burrowed deep down into the earth. They are long and dark and often bend so that losing one's way is practically inevitable.

description.name: Slender Stone Bridge, Stairway

A large mouth has been carved into the stone of the southern wall.

description.name: Giant Fortress, Path of Bones

description.name: Small Room
description.description: This small room appears to have been used for storage at some point. Lately, however, it has been used as a sort of home, as there is a makeshift bed, and boxes serving as tables. The occupant is obviously not here, but you can guess why... there is a large hole apparently smashed into the west wall, and you can clearly see a thick trail of dried blood leading into it.

description.name: Lagoon, Reef
description.description: The reef actually comes out of the water here, making it possible to walk across it. Small tide pools filled with small crabs and other shellfish liter the reef's surface. Walking is a little awkward as the rough coral edges make your footing less stable then you would like. Often, a large shape is visible in the waters beyond the reef.

description.name: Blackwood Forest
description.description: You are travelling in a dark forest, thick with trees and brush. Snow weighs down the branches and occasionally falls in clumps to the ground as the wind shifts.  There is an abnormal chill that reaches deep into your bones as you travel through here.  Despite the snow, a faint stench of rot wafts on the breeze.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel, Dead End
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

description.name: Black Wasteland
description.description: This vast bleak plain is covered in knee-high grass the colour of soot. Great cracks split the floor of the wasteland, out of which towering grey plumes of smoke reach towards the sky. Two moons, one yellow and one blue, ride high above in the lavender heavens. There are no landmarks save the moons, and a slight disorientating effect pervading the area makes it difficult to navigate.

description.name: Tilled Fields
description.description: This broad field has rows of neatly tilled soil. The smell of the freshly-turned earth is quite pleasant, and the earth itself is soft underfoot. Some of the fields sport tall crops, while others lay just planted.

description.name: Hazy Swamp
description.description: This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.

description.name: Castle, Dark Hallway

description.name: Earthen Tunnel

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels
description.description: You are on a wide path that winds up and down, and seems to curve at odd angles. The black rock that shapes these uneven walls seems to absorb the light around you. Thick mold grows in the crevices of the walls, filling the air with moisture. You hear soft whispering noises, and wonder what might be in here with you.

description.name: Barren Hills, Northern Overlook
description.description: A steep climb lies to the north. You can spot what looks like caves dotting the mountainside and a trail winding its way to the top. From here you also have a good view of the barren wasteland below. You notice a fortress to the southeast that would be hidden from any other angle.

description.name: Blackwood Forest
description.description: You are travelling in a dark forest, thick with trees and brush. Snow weighs down the branches and occasionally falls in clumps to the ground as the wind shifts. description.name: Sewer Tunnel
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills

description.name: Black Wasteland
description.description: This vast bleak plain is covered in knee-high grass the colour of soot. description.name: Tilled Fields

description.name: Hazy Swamp
description.description: This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

description.name: Black Wasteland
description.description: This vast bleak plain is covered in knee-high grass the colour of soot. Great cracks split the floor of the wasteland, out of which towering grey plumes of smoke reach towards the sky. Two moons, one yellow and one blue, ride high above in the lavender heavens. There are no landmarks save the moons, and a slight disorientating effect pervading the area makes it difficult to navigate.

description.name: Tilled Fields
description.description: This broad field has rows of neatly tilled soil. The smell of the freshly-turned earth is quite pleasant, and the earth itself is soft underfoot. Some of the fields sport tall crops, while others lay just planted.

description.name: Hazy Swamp
description.description: This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.

description.name: Closet
description.description: This is a small chamber, lined with cedar shelving for holding towels, bedding, and the like. It smells somewhat fragrant as the laundry is kept fresh.

description.name: Earthen Tunnel
description.description: These narrow tunnels are made of packed earth and stones, laborously burrowed deep down into the earth. They are long and dark and often bend so that losing one's way is practically inevitable.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels
description.description: You are on a wide path that winds up and down, and seems to curve at odd angles. The black rock that shapes these uneven walls seems to absorb the light around you. Thick mold grows in the crevices of the walls, filling the air with moisture. You hear soft whispering noises, and wonder what might be in here with you.

description.name: Barren Hills, Valley Wall
description.description: A steep valley wall to the east looks impassible. The dirt and rocks holding it together are loosely packed and crumble when you attempt to climb. A narrow track winds to the north and south. The land is completely devoid of vegetation here. Ocassionally a path or dry creek bed branches off to the east.

Great cracks split the floor of the wasteland, out of which towering grey plumes of smoke reach towards the sky. Two moons, one yellow and one blue, ride high above in the lavender heavens. There are no landmarks save the moons, and a slight disorientating effect pervading the area makes it difficult to navigate.

description.name: Tilled Fields
description.description: This broad field has rows of neatly tilled soil. The smell of the freshly-turned earth is quite pleasant, and the earth itself is soft underfoot. Some of the fields sport tall crops, while others lay just planted.

description.name: Hazy Swamp
description.description: This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.

description.name: Royal Entry Hall
description.description: This is a magnificently-decorated hallway. It is quite unlike anything on the lower floors of the castle, as beautiful tapestries line the walls and a luxuriant carpet is thick on the floor. Intricately- carved pillars provide support for the twenty-foot ceiling.

description.name: Earthen Tunnel
description.description: These narrow tunnels are made of packed earth and stones, laborously burrowed deep down into the earth. They are long and dark and often bend so that losing one's way is practically inevitable.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels
description.description: You are on a wide path that winds up and down, and seems to curve at odd angles. The black rock that shapes these uneven walls seems to absorb the light around you. Thick mold grows in the crevices of the walls, filling the air with moisture. You hear soft whispering noises, and wonder what might be in here with you.

description.name: Barren Hills, Valley Wall
description.description: A steep valley wall to the east looks impassible. The dirt and rocks holding it together are loosely packed and crumble when you attempt to climb. A narrow track winds to the north and south. The land is completely devoid of vegetation here. Ocassionally a path or dry creek bed branches off to the east.

description.name: Blackwood Forest, Garden
description.description: The plants in this section of the forest stand out oddly, since they are not native to this land. They also seem to be lush and green, and thriving happily in the frosty weather. Judging by the clearly lined path, it seems as if they have been strategically planted to guide you to a specific destination. The smell of rotting flesh is quite pungent in the garden.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

A skylight above appears to have a spell cast upon it to give the illusion of a clear night sky, complete with stars.

description.name: Hazy Swamp
description.description: This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.

description.name: Abandoned Warehouse
description.description: This old, rickety wooden building reeks of decay and forgotten wares. Piles of dusty crates lay about the area, their contents long rotted or rusted to uselessness. The warehouse continues to the east and south.

description.name: Earthen Tunnel
description.description: These narrow tunnels are made of packed earth and stones, laborously burrowed deep down into the earth. They are long and dark and often bend so that losing one's way is practically inevitable.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels
description.description: You are on a wide path that winds up and down, and seems to curve at odd angles. The black rock that shapes these uneven walls seems to absorb the light around you. Thick mold grows in the crevices of the walls, filling the air with moisture. You hear soft whispering noises, and wonder what might be in here with you.

description.name: Barren Hills, Valley Wall
description.description: A steep valley wall to the east looks impassible. The dirt and rocks holding it together are loosely packed and crumble when you attempt to climb. A narrow track winds to the north and south. The land is completely devoid of vegetation here. Ocassionally a path or dry creek bed branches off to the east.

description.name: Blackwood Forest, Garden
description.description: The plants in this section of the forest stand out oddly, since they are not native to this land. They also seem to be lush and green, and thriving happily in the frosty weather. Judging by the clearly lined path, it seems as if they have been strategically planted to guide you to a specific destination. The smell of rotting flesh is quite pungent in the garden.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

description.name: Black Wasteland
description.description: This vast bleak plain is covered in knee-high grass the colour of soot. Great cracks split the floor of the wasteland, out of which towering grey plumes of smoke reach towards the sky. Two moons, one yellow and one blue, ride high above in the lavender heavens. There are no landmarks save the moons, and a slight disorientating effect pervading the area makes it difficult to navigate.

The road passing through this forest is barely lit as the canopy of branches overhead nearly blocks out the light from the sun.

description.name: Black Wasteland
description.description: This vast bleak plain is covered in knee-high grass the colour of soot. description.name: Rocky Path
description.description: This narrow, rock-strewn path twists its way up the gently climbing slope. In many places the path has nearly vanished due to neglect and disuse, the stones concealing its presence. Here and there, however, small bootprints can be seen in the mud.

description.name: Hazy Swamp
description.description: This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.

description.name: Building Rooftop
description.description: The mouldy shingles of this roof are missing in many places, and their slickness makes movement difficult. The jagged spires of the Dragon's teeth hills can be seen far off to the west, and the city of Silvermere lies to the north.

description.name: Darkwood Forest, Keep Wall
description.description: This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way. The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. They press in close against the outside wall of the keep, where an extremely narrow trail passes amongst the trunks.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Darkened Tunnels
description.description: You are on a wide path that winds up and down, and seems to curve at odd angles. The black rock that shapes these uneven walls seems to absorb the light around you. Thick mold grows in the crevices of the walls, filling the air with moisture. You hear soft whispering noises, and wonder what might be in here with you.

description.name: Barren Hills

To the north you see what can only be stone walls.

description.name: Blackwood Forest, Garden

They also seem to be lush and green, and thriving happily in the frosty weather. Judging by the clearly lined path, it seems as if they have been strategically planted to guide you to a specific destination. The smell of rotting flesh is quite pungent in the garden.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel

Great cracks split the floor of the wasteland, out of which towering grey plumes of smoke reach towards the sky. Two moons, one yellow and one blue, ride high above in the lavender heavens. There are no landmarks save the moons, and a slight disorientating effect pervading the area makes it difficult to navigate.

description.name: Rocky Path
description.description: This narrow, rock-strewn path twists its way up the gently climbing slope. In many places the path has nearly vanished due to neglect and disuse, the stones concealing its presence. Here and there, however, small bootprints can be seen in the mud.

description.name: Cracked Plain, Black Chasm
description.description: The earth here is dry and stony, and appears to have been broken by some incredible force. It is heavily riddled with cracks of varying size, some nearly wide enough to fit into. The uneven surface makes footing a little difficult, but it is possible to pick a relatively safe path. A gaping black chasm splits the earth to the west, so huge and dark it seems bottomless.

description.name: Building Rooftop
description.description: The mouldy shingles of this roof are missing in many places, and their slickness makes movement difficult. The jagged spires of the Dragon's teeth hills can be seen far off to the west, and the city of Silvermere lies to the north.

description.name: Darkwood Forest, Keep Wall
description.description: This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way. The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. They press in close against the outside wall of the keep, where an extremely narrow trail passes amongst the trunks. An unusually tall darkwood tree grows right beside the wall here, its branches hanging out over the interior of the wall.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Barren Hills
description.description: You are following a wide path running north and south. The soil is packed hard with a fine layer of powdery dust on the top. Occasionally a small wind picks up and blows the dust into your face, making you cough. To the north you see what can only be stone walls.

description.name: Blackwood Forest
description.description: This trail leads through a dark forest, thick with trees and brush. Snow weighs down the branches and occasionally falls in clumps to the ground as the wind shifts.  There is an abnormal chill that reaches deep into your bones as you travel through here.  Despite the snow, a faint stench of rot wafts on the breeze.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel, Dead End
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages. An iron ladder leads up through a manhole overhead here.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

description.name: Black Wasteland
description.description: This vast bleak plain is covered in knee-high grass the colour of soot. Great cracks split the floor of the wasteland, out of which towering grey plumes of smoke reach towards the sky. Two moons, one yellow and one blue, ride high above in the lavender heavens. There are no landmarks save the moons, and a slight disorientating effect pervading the area makes it difficult to navigate.

description.name: Cramped Tunnel
description.description: The ceiling of this crude tunnel is quite low, forcing anyone taller than five feet tall to duck in fear of hitting his head. Garbage is prominent here, and the smell is quite bad-- who or whatever lives here does not place cleanliness highly. The tunnel exits out of the mountain here.

description.name: Cracked Plain, Cavern Wall
description.description: The earth here is dry and stony, and appears to have been broken by some incredible force. It is heavily riddled with cracks of varying size, some nearly wide enough to fit into. The uneven surface makes footing a little difficult, but it is possible to pick a relatively safe path. The stone wall of the cavern reaches up into the utter darkness here.

description.name: Building Rooftop
description.description: The mouldy shingles of this roof are missing in many places, and their slickness makes movement difficult. The jagged spires of the Dragon's teeth hills can be seen far off to the west, and the city of Silvermere lies to the north.

description.name: Forest Keep, Wall Edge
description.description: The stone wall of this keep is not very wide, and the narrow walk around the perimeter only allows for two to walk abreast. The stone is a pale grey, flecked with white, with a great amount of moss covering every surface.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Glacial Cavern, Stairway
description.description: Walls of solid ice offer little solace as step, after icy step leads you further into darkness. You can feel a chilling breeze hit your face every so often, numbing your senses and chilling your bones. Sometimes you find it hard to continue the downward spiral, and sometimes catch yourself about to slip on the frigid, unforgiving steps.

description.name: Barren Hills
description.description: You are following a wide path that winds up and down rolling hills. A few hills are steep enough that you have to detour around them. The soil is packed hard with a fine layer of powdery dust on the top. Occasionally a small wind picks up and blows the dust into your face, making you cough. You wonder what could have happened here to destroy all sign of vegetation. Occasionally you hear a rumbling in the distance.

description.name: Blackwood Forest
description.description: This trail leads through a dark forest, thick with trees and brush. Snow weighs down the branches and occasionally falls in clumps to the ground as the wind shifts.  There is an abnormal chill that reaches deep into your bones as you travel through here.  Despite the snow, a faint stench of rot wafts on the breeze.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

There is an abnormal chill that reaches deep into your bones as you travel through here.  Despite the snow, a faint stench of rot wafts on the breeze.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

description.name: Black Wasteland
description.description: This vast bleak plain is covered in knee-high grass the colour of soot. Great cracks split the floor of the wasteland, out of which towering grey plumes of smoke reach towards the sky. Two moons, one yellow and one blue, ride high above in the lavender heavens. There are no landmarks save the moons, and a slight disorientating effect pervading the area makes it difficult to navigate.

description.name: Smelly Cave
description.description: This long cave is simply a widening of the standard tunnel, closed off at the ends by doors and converted into some sort of living area. Dingy pallets of straw cover the floor seemingly at random, and garbage is strewn everywhere. The smell is quite horrible, and the overall filth of the place is appalling. A small wooden door has been set in the southern wall here.

description.name: Cracked Plain, Cavern Wall
description.description: The earth here is dry and stony, and appears to have been broken by some incredible force. It is heavily riddled with cracks of varying size, some nearly wide enough to fit into. The uneven surface makes footing a little difficult, but it is possible to pick a relatively safe path. The stone wall of the cavern reaches up into the utter darkness here.

description.name: Building Rooftop
description.description: The mouldy shingles of this roof are missing in many places, and their slickness makes movement difficult. The jagged spires of the Dragon's teeth hills can be seen far off to the west, and the city of Silvermere lies to the north.

description.name: Forest Keep, Wall Edge
description.description: The stone wall of this keep is not very wide, and the narrow walk around the perimeter only allows for two to walk abreast. The stone is a pale grey, flecked with white, with a great amount of moss covering every surface.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Glacial Cavern, Stairway
description.description: Walls of solid ice offer little solace as step, after icy step leads you further into darkness. You can feel a chilling breeze hit your face every so often, numbing your senses and chilling your bones. Sometimes you find it hard to continue the downward spiral, and sometimes catch yourself about to slip on the frigid, unforgiving steps.

description.name: Barren Hills
description.description: You are following a wide path that winds up and down rolling hills. A few hills are steep enough that you have to detour around them. The soil is packed hard with a fine layer of powdery dust on the top. Occasionally a small wind picks up and blows the dust into your face, making you cough. You wonder what could have happened here to destroy all sign of vegetation. Occasionally you hear a rumbling in the distance.

description.name: Barren Hills

The soil is packed hard with a fine layer of powdery dust on the top. Occasionally a small wind picks up and blows the dust into your face, making you cough. To the north you see what can only be stone walls.

description.name: Blackwood Forest

description.name: Sewer Tunnel, Intersection

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills

description.name: Smelly Cave

description.name: Cracked Plain, Cavern Wall

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Black Ice Cavern, Twisting Tunnel
description.description: The cold in this tunnel almost seems to sap the life from your bones. Chipped and jagged pitch black ice twists and turns like a snake to make up this tunnel path. All light seems to be eaten by the walls and ceiling, leaving an occasional icy glitter on the walls.

description.name: Barren Hills
description.description: You are following a winding path. The soil is packed hard with a fine layer of powdery dust on the top. Occasionally a small wind picks up and blows the dust into your face, making you cough. To the north you see what can only be stone walls.

description.name: Gypsy Encampment
description.description: The contrast between the dark Blackwood Forest and the gypsy camp are as night and day.  Colorful wagons surround a large fire in the middle with cookpots almost set to boil. You sense you are being watched yet the gypsys don't seem to even recognize your existance. You take caustious steps from here, for angering the gypsyies has ended many a foolish life.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Black Ice Cavern, Twisting Tunnel
description.description: The cold in this tunnel almost seems to sap the life from your bones. Chipped and jagged pitch black ice twists and turns like a snake to make up this tunnel path. All light seems to be eaten by the walls and ceiling, leaving an occasional icy glitter on the walls.

description.name: Barren Hills
description.description: This side path flattens out in comparison to the rolling hills surrounding you. You notice that it is well trodden and not quite as dusty, probably from all the travel. As it slopes gently downward you see a stone wall nearby to the east. You've caught glimpses of it from the distance and are finally near your destination.

description.name: Blackwood Forest
description.description: This trail leads through a dark forest, thick with trees and brush. Snow weighs down the branches and occasionally falls in clumps to the ground as the wind shifts.  There is an abnormal chill that reaches deep into your bones as you travel through here.  Despite the snow, a faint stench of rot wafts on the breeze.

description.name: Dark Tunnel
description.description: This is a cramped, dark tunnel. The smell of some revolting beast is strong here, and you can feel the slickness of droppings underneath your feet as you walk. The occasional crack of breaking bones startles you, and as you look down you can see the carcasses of many small animals littering the ground.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

description.name: Darkwood Forest
description.description: This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way. The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. Their thick, knotted branches twist every which way so that they appear to be contorted in pain, though this is surely not the case. The leaves are a dark green, and are nearly as thick as leather. The road passing through this forest is barely lit as the canopy of branches overhead nearly blocks out the light from the sun.

description.name: Cramped Tunnel
description.description: The ceiling of this crude tunnel is quite low, forcing anyone taller than five feet tall to duck in fear of hitting his head. Garbage is prominent here, and the smell is quite bad-- who or whatever lives here does not place cleanliness highly.

description.name: Cracked Plain, Black Chasm
description.description: The earth here is dry and stony, and appears to have been broken by some incredible force. It is heavily riddled with cracks of varying size, some nearly wide enough to fit into. The uneven surface makes footing a little difficult, but it is possible to pick a relatively safe path. A gaping black chasm splits the earth to the west, so huge and dark it seems bottomless.

description.name: Building Rooftop
description.description: The mouldy shingles of this roof are missing in many places, and their slickness makes movement difficult. The jagged spires of the Dragon's teeth hills can be seen far off to the west, and the city of Silvermere lies to the north. It might be possible, with a little luck, to jump across to the building to the east.

description.name: Keep Wall Path
description.description: This wide pathway travels between the outer keep wall and the inner keep. The walls are made of pale stone and are covered in cracks and moss, though despite this they still appear sturdy. The path continues to the east and west.

description.name: Barren Hills, Fortress Wall
description.description: This dusty path comes to a massive wall, set together by massive wooden stakes. A constant rumbling seems to emanate from inside the huge walls. The path turns to the south and you can only assume it leads to the entrance of what must be a large fortress. All along the top of the wall you note various skulls hung as trophies.

description.name: Isle of Shadow
description.description: A starless void above you reflects the deep, unsettling black of the land you stand on. Surrounded by ink black water, the tide thrashes about, ready to devour you, plunge you into its dusky dephts. Shadows dance about your feet, twisted and nightmarish, you realize the shadow comes from you, but warped in a sick, bestial form. No immediate path back, and for the moment you seem stranded on this shadow land.

description.name: Black Wasteland
description.description: This vast bleak plain is covered in knee-high grass the colour of soot. Great cracks split the floor of the wasteland, out of which towering grey plumes of smoke reach towards the sky. Two moons, one yellow and one blue, ride high above in the lavender heavens. There are no landmarks save the moons, and a slight disorientating effect pervading the area makes it difficult to navigate.

It is heavily riddled with cracks of varying size, some nearly wide enough to fit into. The uneven surface makes footing a little difficult, but it is possible to pick a relatively safe path. A gaping black chasm splits the earth to the west, so huge and dark it seems bottomless.

description.name: Building Rooftop
description.description: The mouldy shingles of this roof are missing in many places, and their slickness makes movement difficult. The jagged spires of the Dragon's teeth hills can be seen far off to the west, and the city of Silvermere lies to the north.

description.name: Keep Wall Path
description.description: This wide pathway travels between the outer keep wall and the inner keep. The walls are made of pale stone and are covered in cracks and moss, though despite this they still appear sturdy. The path continues to the east and west.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland. To the northwest, a wavering image of paradise shimmers in the heat.

description.name: Black Ice Cavern, Freezing Tunnel
description.description: You find it hard to go through these black tunnels, each shivering step harder then the last. You try not to make much sound but the tunnels echo the chattering of your teeth. You think you can faintly see light ahead, or it could be your eyeballs are freezing over.

description.name: Giant Fortress, Firepit
description.description: A massive firepit fills the area with waves of heat, several large animals are spitted over a fire of their own, their burning smell adding to the smoke of the large fire. You see drums lying around, and can see the stamping of many massive feet in the dirt, leading you to think this is a setting for a war party.

description.name: Blackwood Forest, Winding Trail
description.description: This trail leads through a dark forest, thick with trees and brush. Snow weighs down the branches and occasionally falls in clumps to the ground as the wind shifts.  There is an abnormal chill that reaches deep into your bones as you travel through here.  Despite the snow, a faint stench of rot wafts on the breeze.

description.name: Sewer Tunnel
description.description: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

description.name: Dragon's Teeth Hills
description.description: This is a narrow gravel path winding its way through the mazelike hills. They are called the Dragon's Teeth because their sheer faces are extremely jagged, and are streaked through with deep red metallic veins-- making them appear as if they are dripping blood. Many an adventurer has tried to scale them, but to no avail. Strange and deadly creatures are known to stalk these hills, further adding to their shadowy reputation.

description.name: Cramped Tunnel
description.description: The ceiling of this crude tunnel is quite low, forcing anyone taller than five feet tall to duck in fear of hitting his head. Garbage is prominent here, and the smell is quite bad-- who or whatever lives here does not place cleanliness highly.

description.name: Cramped Tunnel

description.name: Cracked Plain

description.name: Building Rooftop
description.description: The mouldy shingles of this roof are missing in many places, and their slickness makes movement difficult. The jagged spires of the Dragon's teeth hills can be seen far off to the west, and the city of Silvermere lies to the north.

description.name: Living Quarters
description.description: These rectangular living quarters are quite unremarkable, and are indifferently kept. Only a semblance of cleanliness is evident, with clothing strewn about haphazardly, and household items and boxes stacked in corners.

description.name: Scorching Desert
description.description: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

description.name: Black Ice Cavern, Twisting Tunnel
description.description: The cold in this tunnel almost seems to sap the life from your bones. Chipped and jagged pitch black ice twists and turns like a snake to make up this tunnel path. All light seems to be eaten by the walls and ceiling, leaving an occasional icy glitter on the walls.

description.name: Barren Hills
description.description: You are following a wide path that winds up and down rolling hills. A few hills are steep enough that you have to detour around them. The soil is packed hard with a fine layer of powdery dust on the top. Occasionally a small wind picks up and blows the dust into your face, making you cough. You wonder what could have happened here to destroy all sign of vegetation. Occasionally you hear a rumbling in the distance.
